# Third-party components

- Transformers.js 3.8.1: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers.js — Apache-2.0. See TRANSFORMERS-LICENSE.txt.
- Jitsi rnnoise-wasm 0.2.1: https://github.com/jitsi/rnnoise-wasm — Apache-2.0 wrapper. See RNNOISE-WASM-LICENSE.txt.
- RNNoise classic model/library: https://github.com/xiph/rnnoise — BSD license. See RNNOISE-LICENSE.txt. The classic WASM bundled in the Jitsi package is used to fit the stable runtime loader size limit.
- ONNX Runtime Web 1.22.0-dev.20250409-89f8206ba4: https://github.com/microsoft/onnxruntime — MIT; downloaded from the pinned npm CDN during local subtitle setup.
- Whisper tiny ONNX model: https://huggingface.co/onnx-community/whisper-tiny — public model downloaded directly by the user's browser; source and model notices are available from that repository.
- Artplayer 5.4.0: https://github.com/zhw2590582/ArtPlayer — MIT.
- MP4Box.js 2.3.0: https://github.com/gpac/mp4box.js — BSD.
